cells: row 71 column I (Source code evidence: editIteration.jsp:54,57 calendar button)
row 69 column E (calendar buttons follow the session bundle)
findings.observed: On the iteration editor the Calendar buttons (input type=image, onclick "return showCalendar(id, format.date)") call a function the page never defines: the page loads jquery, jquery-ui, global.js and tooltip.js only; /calendar/calendar.js and calendarHelper.js are included only by timesheet.jsp and aggregateTimesheet.jsp. A click throws "ReferenceError: showCalendar is not defined" and the image button submits the editor form (redisplay "Missing iteration name." in en, "Falta el nombre de la iteracion." in es when the name is empty). No date is inserted. The jQuery picker inserts yyyy-MM-dd in en and es and those dates are stored as picked.
findings.expected: The calendar button inserts the session bundle format.date (dd-MM-yyyy in es), which the server default converter then misreads.
findings.minimal_correction: Row 71 (and row 69 wherever it says the calendar buttons insert a format): state that the iteration editor calendar buttons do nothing but submit the form (script not included; ReferenceError), so only the jQuery picker inserts dates (always yyyy-MM-dd, stored as picked on this yyyy-MM-dd server); the dd-MM-yyyy misreading applies to typed dates only. Expected: a click on a filled, valid form saves it (Inferred, not observed).

findings.observed: When the recalculated remaining hours would be negative, the field shows 0 and only the "remaining hours" label turns red (editTimeEntries.js entryChanged). The recalculation runs on change of start, end, duration or delete; Insert Time alone does not trigger it.
findings.minimal_correction: Row 151 column G: "Remaining hours recalculated on change of an entry; a negative result is shown as 0 with the label in red; task estimate updated on save."
